donorReadme: - Source: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute Color Maps of Dione - 2014 (PIA18434)
- Purpose: Cassini global color map for the explorable Dione moon pack
- Processing: checked in from the full-resolution `14134x7067` JPEG source
- Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Dione release uses the NASA/JPL PIA18434 Cassini global color map. Source coordinates in the USGS Gazetteer use Dione's IAU planetographic, positive-west, 0-360 system; because this texture is registered like Tethys, numeric marker longitudes use `markerLongitude = 180 - westLongitude`, normalized to `[-180, 180]`.
